# MIAGAZINE

> MIAGAZINE is a bilingual (English/Spanish) digital luxury magazine about Miami, founded in 2026. It publishes photographic editorials by a curated network of Miami photographers and a researched, sourced Journal on fashion & models, real estate, economy, music, trends, food & drink, tech, waterfront, design & architecture and photography, plus a free weekly newsletter, The Lens (Thursdays).

Key facts:
- Coverage: Miami and South Florida.
- Photographers submit for free, keep copyright, get full credit and earn 20% on partnerships they refer.
- Advertising founding rates: newsletter sponsorship $150/issue, MIA Selects listing $99/month, Branded Story $650, Event Coverage $900, Founding Partner $1,500/year.
- Editorial policy: real photography only; paid content labeled "Partner"; speculative pieces labeled as fiction.

## Journal (English)
- [Miami Art Week 2026 for Free: The Smart Guide to Basel Week](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-art-week-2026-free-guide.html): Art Basel Miami Beach runs Dec 4–6, but the best of Miami Art Week costs nothing. Here is how to see it by neighborhood, from Collins Park to the Design District.
- [Miami Luxury Real Estate 2026: Logos in the Sky, Cracks Below](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-luxury-real-estate-2026.html): Supercar towers, a 1,049-foot Waldorf and a $4.3M entry ticket to the top 5%. Meanwhile, Miami's older condos are paying for Surfside. Here's the 2026 market.
- [The Best Places to Photograph in Miami: The Definitive Guide](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/best-photo-spots-miami.html): 18 spots, the exact light to chase, and what nobody tells you: when you need a permit, where your drone can't fly and which places charge for a shoot.
- [Wall Street South: How Miami's $260 Billion Economy Really Works](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-economy-wall-street-south.html): A $2.5 billion Citadel tower, 28 million visitors and 8.5 million cruise passengers. Miami's economy is booming, and so is its affordability problem.
- [Michelin in Miami 2026: The Stars, the Bibs and the Bargains](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/michelin-guide-miami-2026.html): Fourteen starred dining rooms, a world-first kosher star and 18 Bib Gourmands. How Miami became Florida's Michelin capital, and how to eat it without going broke.
- [Miami's Tech & AI Scene in 2026: Money, Talent and the Next Wave](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-tech-ai-scene-2026.html): Palantir moved in, AI startups raised $1.23B and eMerge jumps to March 2027. Here's what's real in Miami tech right now.
- [Miami's New Skyline: Supertalls, Art Deco and Starchitects](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-skyline-architecture-2026.html): Miami is about to get its first supertall, and Florida already has a new height record. How to read the city now, from Deco neon to Herzog & de Meuron concrete.
- [Miami's Music Scene in 2027: Ultra, Latin Power and 24-Hour Nights](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-music-scene-2027.html): Ultra returns March 26–28, 2027, but Miami's music story is bigger: the capital of the Latin industry, a club that never closes and arenas booked into spring.
- [Miami on the Water: The Boat Show, the Bay and the Yacht Life](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-yachting-boat-show-2027.html): February 10–14, 2027: the Miami International Boat Show returns. A guide to the city's yacht culture, Biscayne Bay and how to get on the water without owning a boat.
- [Miami Modeling Guide: Swim Week, Agencies and Staying Safe](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-modeling-swim-week-guide.html): From poolside runways to licensed agencies: how Miami's model industry really works, what Swim Week 2027 may bring, and how to spot a scam.
- [Luxury Trends 2027: What Miami Will Want Next](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/luxury-trends-2027.html): Experiences outpace handbags, resale goes mainstream, and longevity becomes the new status symbol. The luxury trends heading into 2027, read through Miami.
- [A Day in Miami, 2035: A Concept-Fiction Tour of the Future City](https://www.miagazine.com/blog/miami-2035-speculative-future.html): Concept fiction: reef seawalls, robot water taxis and lab-grown stone crab. One invented day in 2035 Miami, with reality checks on what exists today.

## Journal (Español)
- [Miami Art Week 2026 gratis: la guía inteligente de la semana Basel](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-art-week-2026-free-guide.html): Art Basel Miami Beach abre del 4 al 6 de diciembre, pero lo mejor de la Miami Art Week no cuesta nada. Cómo recorrerla por barrios, de Collins Park al Design District.
- [Lujo inmobiliario en Miami 2026: logos en el cielo, grietas abajo](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-luxury-real-estate-2026.html): Torres de superdeportivos, un Waldorf de 1,049 pies y $4.3 millones para entrar al top 5%. Mientras, los condos viejos pagan la factura de Surfside.
- [Los mejores lugares para fotografiar en Miami: guía definitiva](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/best-photo-spots-miami.html): 18 spots, la hora exacta de luz y lo que nadie te dice: cuándo necesitas permiso, dónde no puede volar tu dron y qué lugares cobran por la sesión.
- [Wall Street South: así funciona la economía de Miami en 2026](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-economy-wall-street-south.html): Una torre de Citadel de $2,500 millones, 28 millones de visitantes y 8.5 millones de cruceristas. La economía de Miami vuela, y su problema de vivienda también.
- [Un día en Miami, 2035: ficción especulativa de la ciudad futura](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-2035-speculative-future.html): Ficción especulativa: arrecifes-muro, taxis acuáticos sin capitán y cangrejo moro de laboratorio. Un día inventado en 2035, con chequeo de realidad.
- [Tendencias de lujo 2027: lo que Miami querrá después](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/luxury-trends-2027.html): Las experiencias superan a los bolsos, la reventa se vuelve normal y la longevidad es el nuevo símbolo de estatus. Las tendencias de lujo rumbo a 2027, vistas desde Miami.
- [Modelaje en Miami: Swim Week, agencias y cómo evitar estafas](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-modeling-swim-week-guide.html): De las pasarelas sobre la piscina a las agencias con licencia: cómo funciona de verdad el modelaje en Miami, qué esperar del Swim Week 2027 y cómo detectar una estafa.
- [Michelin en Miami 2026: estrellas, Bib Gourmand y cómo comer por menos](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/michelin-guide-miami-2026.html): Catorce restaurantes con estrella, la primera estrella kosher del mundo y 18 Bib Gourmand. Así se convirtió Miami en la capital Michelin de Florida.
- [Miami sobre el agua: el Boat Show, la bahía y la vida en yate](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-yachting-boat-show-2027.html): Del 10 al 14 de febrero de 2027 vuelve el Miami International Boat Show. Guía de la cultura náutica de Miami, la bahía Vizcaína y cómo navegar sin tener yate.
- [La escena tech e IA de Miami en 2026: dinero, talento y lo que viene](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-tech-ai-scene-2026.html): Llegó Palantir, las startups de IA levantaron 1,230 millones y eMerge se adelanta a marzo de 2027. Lo que sí está pasando en el Miami tech.
- [La escena musical de Miami en 2027: Ultra, poder latino y noches de 24 h](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-music-scene-2027.html): Ultra vuelve del 26 al 28 de marzo de 2027, pero la historia musical de Miami es más grande: capital de la industria latina, un club que no cierra y arenas llenas hasta primavera.
- [El nuevo skyline de Miami: supertalls, Art Deco y starchitects](https://www.miagazine.com/es/blog/miami-skyline-architecture-2026.html): Miami está por estrenar su primer supertall y Florida ya tiene nuevo récord de altura. Así se lee hoy la ciudad, del neón Art Deco al hormigón de Herzog & de Meuron.
